entries.summary: Scheduler retries during slow PVC provisioning now preserve the selected node instead of misplacing Pods or rejecting in-progress volumes through duplicate capacity checks.

Migration image defaults `v1.0.4-01` → `v1.2.0` for directory-symlink SFTP errors and ignored listing failures; `localStorage.migrate.juicesync.version` selects JuiceFS (`1.2.0` default, `1.4.1` bundled), requiring compatible Local Storage and migration images.
upgradeNotes: **Operator-managed migrations:** upgrade to an [Operator containing #393](https://github.com/hwameistor/hwameistor-operator/pull/393) alongside Local Storage; set `spec.localStorage.member.juicesyncImage.tag=v1.2.0` when adopting the bundled image.
**Direct Helm image overrides:** to adopt the bundled image, set `localStorage.migrate.juicesync.tag=v1.2.0` alongside updated Local Storage.
**Special-file migrations:** keep `localStorage.migrate.juicesync.version=1.2.0`; `1.4.1` skips FIFOs, sockets, devices and whiteouts even with verification, while `1.2.0` fails.

entries.summary: Migration verification defaults `false` → `true` through `localStorage.migrate.check`; new Jobs use `--check-all` instead of `--check-new`, checking copied and existing files.
upgradeNotes: **Checks intentionally disabled:** set `localStorage.migrate.check=false` explicitly to retain that behavior after upgrading.

excluded.reason: Records historical v1.1.1 release notes; the described product changes predate this release range.
Maintainer-only release automation, publication workflows and editorial configuration; no installed-product behavior changes.
